infobox.usage: Unlocks the corpse room in The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Corpse room key (Corpses) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An old key that has a strong odor of death. Probably opens a morgue or a room where bodies were kept.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Keeper's Word

sections.heading: The Labyrinth
sections.text:
- On Shadow of Tagilla
- In one of six locations. Guaranteed spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the corpse room in The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (multiple very rare Valuables, Containers)
